__comment: The messaging floor's board over the MassTransit meter (exported by Goldpath.ServiceDefaults: AddMeter("MassTransit")). Instrument names follow MassTransit's InstrumentationOptions defaults (masstransit.receive, masstransit.consume, masstransit.consume.fault, masstransit.consume.retry, masstransit.publish, masstransit.consume.duration) as the OTel Prometheus exporter spells them; the app board (templates/goldpath-solution/ops) already reads the same consume/fault pair. The OUTBOX has no meter — it is a table; the runbook's SQL is that panel. Datasource: Prometheus scraping the OTel collector.
title: Goldpath Messaging — bus, consumers, outbox posture

panels.title: Receive vs consume vs faults (per s) — a gap between receive and consume is a filter or deserialization failure
Consume duration p95 (s) by consumer — a rising line is a slow dependency, not a slow bus
Retries (per 5m) by consumer — one consumer retrying is a downstream outage (runbook §4)
Publish rate (per s) — zero while handlers run means nobody publishes through the seam (runbook §3)
